selector.champion: Cutaneous Langerhans cell histiocytosis (LCH) with concurrent evolving acute myeloid leukemia (AML)
selector.rationale: The presence of a diffuse atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells positive for CD207/langerin and the identification of identical pathogenic variations in the ASXL1, IDH2, and STAG2 genes in both bone marrow and skin biopsy specimens support the diagnosis of cutaneous Langerhans cell histiocytosis with concurrent evolving acute myeloid leukemia.
